event: US jobless claims today, likely 15:30 SAST (time UNVERIFIED). US PPI Fri 13 Nov, 15:30 SAST.

bullets.title: Nvidia shock
bullets.text: The WSJ reported Nvidia's board is preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang, and Nvidia fell about 7% before the US open (Reuters).

bullets.title: Nasdaq hit hardest
bullets.text: Nasdaq 100 futures fell about 0.9% against about 0.4% for S&P 500 futures, because the selling is in AI and chip names (Bloomberg, investingLive).

bullets.title: Not all tech
bullets.text: AMD and Broadcom rose after hours, while Super Micro, Oracle and CoreWeave fell with Nvidia (investingLive).

bullets.title: Gives back Wednesday
bullets.text: The drop threatens to erase Wednesday's rally, when the Nasdaq Composite rose about 1.6% on renewed AI buying (Yahoo Finance, Reuters).

bullets.title: Rates headwind
bullets.text: Hotter-than-expected US inflation has traders betting on a bigger Fed hike in December, which weighs on tech valuations (Yahoo Finance).

bullets.title: China angle
bullets.text: China urged the US not to use the Nvidia story to justify more chip export limits, and Alibaba and Tencent report results soon (Yahoo Finance via Bloomberg).

buy.title: Buy plan: 27,957 hold (counter-trend)

keys.label: Buy zone
keys.value: 27,957, ideally as the 16:30 open sweeps your range low

look: This is counter-trend. The bias is down, so use half size or skip it.
The open spike sweeps your range low near 27,957 and a 5-min candle closes back inside the range.
Nvidia stops falling and the other chip names (AMD, Broadcom) hold up.
Jobless claims at 15:30 come in without a big surprise.
Take some profit at 28,165 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Buying the first red candle after 16:30. Wait for the sweep and the close back inside.
More Nvidia headlines during the session can drag the whole index lower fast.
Strong US data can add to Fed hike bets and push tech lower.
Moving your stop lower when price gets close. That is how a small loss becomes a big one.

sell.title: Sell plan: bounce into 28,284-28,300

look: The 16:30 open spikes up through your range high and a 5-min candle closes back inside, near 28,284-28,300.
Nvidia stays weak after the US open.
S&P 500 futures also turn lower, so it is not only a Nasdaq move.
Take some profit at 28,165 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Selling now at 28,281, in the middle with no level to lean on. Wait for the sweep at the open.
